description: Purge cached copies of the given URLs, hosts, prefixes or tags in one zone, up to 100 at a time; nothing stored is deleted, the next requests fetch from the origin; for the whole cache use cloudflare_zone_cache_purge_all.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

hosts.description: 1–100 host names to purge from the cache.

prefixes.description: 1–100 prefixes (host/path…) to purge from the cache.

tags.description: 1–100 cache tags to purge from the cache.

urls.description: 1–100 URLs to purge from the cache.

name: cloudflare_zone_cache_purge

purge_id.description: The Cloudflare purge identifier, if returned.

items.description: The normalized items that were purged.

kind.description: The kind of cache entries purged.

zone.description: The zone whose cache was purged.

title: Purge Cloudflare zone cache
